title: Consolidate Protocol Types Into Framework Core
description: framework/core/js/index.ts must become the single source of truth for "protocol" types that mirror the Rust framework/core/rs/lib.rs manifest/UI-tree shape and cross the plugin/wasm boundary. framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx currently re-declares many of these (WindowLayout family, NamedLayout, ActionDescriptor, the Ui-prefixed node family, PluginManifest, ToolNode/ToolLeaf/ToolCategory, UiInspectorFieldGroup, FRAMEWORK_PANEL_TAB_* constants, UI_INSPECTOR_MIXED_PLACEHOLDER, AppDefinition-ish types, WindowEngagement family, WindowMeasure, UiSelectItem, UiKeyValueEntry, UiTreeItemAction) even though os-shell.tsx already imports WindowLayout/NamedLayout types from "@semio-tech/framework-core" — a real duplicate-declaration conflict. Fix: delete the os-shell.tsx local re-declarations of WindowLayout/NamedLayout/WindowLayoutWindowNode/StackNode/AxisNode entirely and keep only the existing import. Move every other protocol-only type/const from os-shell.tsx into core/js/index.ts (fold any Ui-node member types os-shell has that core's UiNode union lacks into core's union so core becomes the complete superset). Keep renderer-private view-model types (ActiveSession, LoadedPluginState, etc.) in os-shell, merged into a single renderer-private types region. Also add two new exported types to core/js/index.ts: ComponentKind (union of the actual componentKind string literals used across the 11 host files in framework/renderer/react/components, found by grep, not guessed) and ComponentSceneHostProps = { readonly node: UiComponentSceneNode; readonly onAction: (action: ActionDescriptor) => void } (using whatever the actual scene-node/action type names in core/js/index.ts turn out to be). Do not run git commands or build/test commands. Do not touch unrelated lines other concurrent sessions are editing in os-shell.tsx or the Rust files.
